votes.section: CONVENE IN THE REGULAR MEETING OF THE CITY COUNCIL
votes.motion: A motion was made by Councilmember McArthur to convene in the Regular Meeting of the City Council.
votes.result: 5-0 Pass (The vote was unanimous and the motion carried.)

votes.section: ADOPT THE TECH RIDGE AMENDED PROJECT AREA PLAN/ORDINANCE
votes.motion: A motion was made by Councilmember Larkin to approve the ordinance to adopt the Amended Project Area Plan for the Tech Ridge Community Development Project Area as the “Official Plan” and related matters.
votes.result: 5-0 Pass (The vote was unanimous and the motion carried.)

votes.motion: A motion was made by Councilmember McArthur to adjourn from the regular meeting and reconvene into the work meeting.
votes.result: 5-0 Pass (The vote was unanimous and the motion carried.)
